meta.title: MemVault memory bridge
meta.description: Puts MemVault's core memory blocks into the system prompt, turns finished conversation windows into stored memories, and adds a memory panel for browsing, review and replay. It also registers memory_search and memory_add, which read and write the same local SQLite store. Everything stays on this machine: without an API key in the MemVault .env, extraction uses offline rules and an offline embedder. Turning the plugin off removes the injection, both tools and the panel.
